newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Northwest estimates cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Northwest estimates cut.

text.p: --Gruntal & Co analyst Steve Lewins said he cut his estimates for Northwest Airlines Corp to $2.50 per share from $3.00 per share for the third quarter, and to $6.50 per share from $6.75 per share for all of 1996.
--Shares in the airline were up 1/4 to 35-5/8.

--"The surge in fuel prices since July and the sluggish retreat stemming from low home-heating oil inventories compels us to reduce estimates for NWAC, as we have for other airlines. Yen currency adjustments are also negative," Lewins said.
